```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(glue)
library(here)

source(here("mogp-utils.R"))
```

The purpose of this notebook is to generate draws from a multi-output spectral mixture Gaussian process with known hyperparameter values:

- $w_i$: magnitude/weight
- $\Sigma_i$: spectral width/variance
- $\mu_i$: spectral frequency/mean
- $\theta_i$: delay
- $\phi_i$: phase

```{r}
D <- 2
Q <- 1

n_points_per_band <- 150

pct_missing <- 0.3
noise_sigma <- 0.05

i <- 1
errored <- TRUE
output <- NULL

output <- sim_D2_Q1(
  tstart = 0,
  tend = 10,
  n_per_band = n_points_per_band, 
  masked_pct = pct_missing,
  noise = rep(noise_sigma, 2),
  w = c(1,1.5),
  mu = c(2,2.2),
  Sigma = c(1,1),
  theta = c(0, .2),
  phi = c(0,0)
)

output_params <- output[[1]]
output_df <- output[[2]]
output_params
```

```{r}
output_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = t, y = y, alpha = ifelse(masked, 0.2, 1), colour = d) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_rug(sides = "b", position = "jitter") +
  labs(title = paste("Seed =", output_params$seed), colour = "Band") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
str(output_df)
```

```{r}
output_filename_stub <- glue("D{D}-Q{Q}-seed{output_params$seed[1]}-n{n_points_per_band*D}-mnar{pct_missing}-noise{noise_sigma}")

df_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-sim.csv")
param_output_filename <- glue("{output_filename_stub}-param.tsv")

write_csv(
  output_df |>
    filter(!masked) |> 
    select(-masked), 
  here("data", df_output_filename)
)

write_tsv(
  output_params, 
  here("data", param_output_filename)
)
```
